UV-Vis spectroscopy is based on the absorption of ultraviolet or visible radiation by molecules, causing electronic transitions of valence electrons from occupied orbitals (bonding or non-bonding) to unoccupied anti-bonding orbitals ($$\sigma^*, \pi^*$$). 

**Interpretation:** The wavelength of maximum absorption ($$\lambda_{\text{max}}$$) indicates the types of bonds and functional groups present (chromophores and auxochromes), while the absorption intensity (molar absorptivity, $$\epsilon$$) helps quantify the concentration and structural features of the sample.
proTip: Keep the definition strictly tied to electronic transitions between bonding/non-bonding and anti-bonding orbitals.
